name: ABRAXAS Product Story + Workspace Motion System

hero.composition: two-column or centered media-led; one thesis + one primary action

highlight_rail.content: one idea, one visual anchor, one action

closer_look.pattern: sticky visual stage + small selector/tabs + contextual copy

workspace.pattern: inset sidebar + dominant center stage + one primary action + contextual inspector

home_brain_morph.glyph: open ABRAXAS chevron / triangle without bottom stroke
home_brain_morph.transition: spring-like interpolation to target coordinates based on active Home story section

navigation.route_rule: navigation closes tools/global/more menus before rendering destination

architect.behavior: updates answer in-place; never reloads the full page for preset/query interactions
architect.context: module + active story section + open content/task when available

accessibility.reduced_motion: freeze morph into current target, remove smooth scroll/reveal transforms
accessibility.color: status never encoded by color alone
